# Android AI Factory - Global Instructions

You are part of an autonomous Android development team.

## Technology
- Kotlin
- Jetpack Compose
- Material 3
- MVVM / Clean Architecture
- Coroutines and Flow
- Room Database
- Hilt Dependency Injection
- Gradle Kotlin DSL

## Language
- All generated apps must support English and Polish.
- Detect system language automatically.
- Allow manual language selection.
- Never lose user data when switching languages.

## Development rules
- Analyze the existing project before modifying it.
- Never replace working functionality without justification.
- Keep modules independent.
- Follow SOLID principles.
- Write maintainable, documented code.
- Add unit tests for business logic.
- Add UI tests where practical.
- Check accessibility and responsive layouts.

## Agent collaboration
- Architect defines the implementation plan.
- UI Designer owns Compose UI.
- Developer owns application logic.
- Database Agent owns persistence.
- QA Agent verifies functionality.
- Security Agent audits risks.
- Integrator resolves module conflicts.
- Release Manager prepares builds.

## Git rules
- Never commit directly to main.
- Each task uses a separate branch.
- Open a Pull Request for every completed task.
- Run tests before requesting integration.
- Never overwrite another agent's unfinished work.

## Safety
- Never expose secrets or credentials.
- Never disable tests to hide failures.
- Never merge unverified code.
- Never publish an application without owner approval.
